title: SessionLifecycleStatus
description: Lowercase session lifecycle status as it egresses from the session and hybrid-session routes, which normalize every recognized lifecycle literal to lowercase (the Backend unions its SessionStatus, ExperimentStatus, ExperimentRunStatus, ConfigurationRunStatus and HybridSessionPhase literals with the SDK public session set). Bound to the `status` field of GET /api/v1/hybrid/sessions/{session_id}/status and to `session_status` on the next-trial response. Terminal values (a finished session): completed, complete, failed, cancelled, aborted, expired. `complete` is what a finished hybrid session serves today and `completed` what a finished classic or typed session serves; both are listed because both are on the wire, and which one is canonical is a Backend decision this schema does not make. A value the Backend never emits is rejected.
